newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israelis wound two Palestinians in Gaza clash.
newsitem.headline: Israelis wound two Palestinians in Gaza clash.

text.p: Israeli troops shot and wounded two Palestinians during clashes on Thursday with hundreds of people who tried to plant olive trees on land seized by Jewish settlers, hospital officials and witnesses said.

They said other Palestinians were overcome by teargas in the clash during which Arabs knocked down a fence erected by Morag settlers earlier this month around hothouses, intruding on Palestinian-owned property.
The director of Khan Younis hospital in Gaza said one Palestinian was shot in the chest while a bullet grazed the head of another protester. He said both were in moderate condition.
"They fired live ammunition in the air and teargas and rubber bullets at the crowd," one witness told Reuters.
An Israeli army spokesman said the army was aware of "some kind of gathering" in Khan Younis and was checking the report. Israeli soldiers guarding the Morag enclave have tanks deployed the area.
Another witness said Palestinian police were trying to restrain Arab demonstrators.
